summary: GNOVA Fintech Platform tested end-to-end. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases passed (health, auth/register/login/me, wallets, deposits min/max/initiate, webhook idempotency with double-credit prevention verified, conversion quote+confirm atomic, withdrawals KYC-gated, transactions pagination, rate alerts CRUD). Frontend: Landing/Login/Dashboard/Deposit/Convert/History/Withdraw all render with Persian RTL; data-testid coverage solid; full login flow with telegram_id=999888777 succeeded, dashboard shows 966,000 IRR total + 4 asset cards; conversion produced live quote with 5-min lock countdown and confirm button; history shows 6 transaction rows.

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' on the asset <select> dropdowns. Likely from dev-instrumentation injected spans inside <option> nodes — non-blocking but pollutes console. Investigate whether asset option label rendering wraps text in a <span>.

action_items: Optional: investigate ConvertPage <option> children to suppress hydration warning
Note: hardcoded exchange rates in server.py (USDT=65000, BTC=2.85B IRR) — main agent flagged as MOCKED; OK for MVP but should be swapped for live feed before prod
Note: Payment gateway PSP is MOCKED via /api/webhooks/payment (signature optional) — flagged in PRD
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: signature verification on /api/webhooks/payment is skipped when x_signature header is absent — webhook is fully open without header. Production must enforce signature presence.

server.py uses 'rate' as float and computes int(amount * rate) for tiny ratios (e.g., 1/2850000000 for IRR->BTC). Loss of precision for small amounts is acceptable for MVP but should use Decimal for stronger ledger integrity.
server.py has hardcoded mock rates in /api/convert/quote — duplicated with /api/wallets total_value calc. Extract to a shared rates module.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup') — migrate to FastAPI lifespan handler.
Two requirements files present (requirements.txt and requirements_new.txt) — consolidate.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates: 1 new registered user (TEST_user_<tg>), 1 webhook event (TEST_webhook_<uuid>) crediting 1000 CREDIT, 1 conversion CREDIT->USDT for 65000 minor units, 1 rate alert USDT->IRR. Cumulative balance changes persist; test_user balance trends upward over runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 20 backend tests passing. Webhook idempotency confirmed (replay returns 'Already processed', no double-credit). Conversion quote -> confirm is atomic via LedgerService.debit + credit. Withdrawal correctly blocked by KYC=pending. Frontend uses GNOVA testid map at /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds/. ConvertPage console hydration warning is the only minor issue. Backend SQLite db at /app/backend/gnova.db. Telegram bot supervisor service RUNNING (not tested with real messages per instructions).
rca of the issue: ConvertPage hydration warning: React 18 strict child rules disallow non-phrasing children inside <option>. The asset <select> options likely render '{asset.name} ({asset.code})' with a wrapping element. Fix: ensure <option> contains only plain text — use a template literal directly without nested elements.
